title: Delivered Equipment Rental and Demo Kit and the Allowance Set Aside From a Finding
content:
Kit that the collective itself carried to the guest's door has spent part of its life outside the shop's sight, and where that is so a share of the amount a damage finding carries is set aside.

## The rule

Where the agreement's rental account carries the package's delivery charge against the agreement, and the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season, the delivered set-aside share of the amount is set aside. The delivered set-aside share is 20 per cent.

Where that rental account carries the package's delivery charge against the agreement and the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation for the season, the bare delivered set-aside share is set aside instead. The bare delivered set-aside share is 10 per cent.

In any other case nothing is set aside under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| Delivery charge on the agreement's rental account | Resort Lodging reservation held for the season | Share of the amount set aside |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 20 per cent |
| yes | no | 10 per cent |
| no | yes | none under this heading |
| no | no | none under this heading |

Both rows that set anything aside turn on the delivery charge. Where no delivery charge stands on the agreement's rental account, the lodging side of the table makes no difference at all.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical finding

Take a finding whose amount stands at 89.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- A delivery charge stands on the agreement and the household holds a lodging reservation for the season: 20 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 17.80 USD, is set aside.
- A delivery charge stands on the agreement and the household holds no lodging reservation for the season: 10 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 8.90 USD, is set aside.
- No delivery charge stands on the agreement: nothing is set aside under this heading.

## Points of judgement

**What is looked for on the rental account.** What is looked for is the package's delivery charge raised against that agreement. Delivery is offered on some packages of the Equipment Rental and Demo line only, and a package that is never delivered will carry no such charge.

**What is looked for on the household's other holdings.** What is looked for is a Resort Lodging reservation held by the household for the season the agreement belongs to, whatever its standing and whatever its folio shows.
